description: Adin Flights by MoodTrip.Ai lets you search, compare and book real flights directly inside ChatGPT using natural language. Powered by LiteAPI's global flight inventory, Adin Flights resolves cities to IATA codes, streams live fares from hundreds of carriers, verifies offers in real time, and hands off to a secure deep-link checkout on flights.moodtrip.ai  Guests can book without an account; signed-in users get booking history, PNR retrieval, and cancellation support — all from chat.
